watch.title: Apple Watch
watch.syncTip: Heart rate and workout metrics from Apple Watch are streamed live to the iPhone during recording.
watch.guideStep1: 1. Open the Remus Watch app on your Apple Watch.
watch.guideStep2: 2. Grant Health (HealthKit) and Motion permissions when prompted.
watch.guideStep3: 3. The watch streams data in real time to the iPhone, which records locally.
watch.guidePermissionsTip: Permissions Tip: HealthKit only displays the prompt on the first install. If you reinstalled the app, verify on your Apple Watch under Settings > Health > Apps > Remus Watch that Heart Rate is enabled.
recording.screenOffTip: Tip: You can lock your screen to save battery. Workout recording will continue normally in the background.

device.gps.antennaNoRf: No RF Signal (Loose cable / low gain)
device.gps.antennaExcellentDesc: Strong and stable signal. Optimal reception for workout tracking.
device.gps.antennaRegularDesc: Moderate signal. GPS is acquiring orbital ephemeris data to lock fix.
device.gps.antennaWeakDesc: Insufficient signal for accurate fix. Point the antenna toward open sky.
device.gps.antennaNoRfDesc: GPS module is responding, but antenna receives no RF. Check antenna connector and keep ceramic face facing upward.
device.gps.antennaNoUartDesc: No NMEA characters received from module. Check 5V/GND power and RX/TX pins.
device.gps.antennaTip: Mounting Tip: Keep the ceramic patch antenna at top of housing facing open sky and away from MicroSD to prevent electromagnetic noise.
